purpose: The commander's order (Or056): a quick team to check that what the commander advised and what was built align; with T012's findings it decides the way forward
roster_note: no roster fits: a two-column comparison. Two clerical readers, one judge

seats.name: advice-reader
seats.reason: lists what the commander advised on this subject, verbatim with its source, no interpretation

seats.name: build-reader
seats.reason: lists what was built and what each part does, no judgement

seats.name: alignment-judge
seats.reason: maps one list to the other: delivered, partly, not delivered, built but never advised
seats.returns: the mapping and a verdict in five lines

shape: readers in parallel, judge waits for both; none sees the critics' reports or the pilot's view; the pilot's own rulings are listed separately from the commander's advice so they cannot pass as his
outcome: Verdict no: what was built does not deliver what the commander advised. 47 advised items against 28 built: document shapes, a shape a new session can write to, reuse of flightcrew's assets and the frontmatter convention not delivered; both tools, the tests, fixtures and zones built but never advised. Drift point named: Ds006 line 11. Maintenance: a room move edits about 70 places in the build; the commander's own idea costs nothing for a room move.
lessons: two blind clerical readers and one judge settled in fifteen minutes what four adversary rounds never asked
list the pilot's rulings apart from the commander's advice in every dossier, so they cannot pass as his
